title: Section title as a doorway into a CSS-3D tunnel
summary: Capsule title mask scrubbed to a computed cover scale (exponential zoom, linear scrub), counter-scaled CSS-3D scene moved on one layer, focus flies a work to the front, plain list under reduced motion
variants: sticky stage, scaled capsule mask with a counter-scaled CSS-3D scene (this)
clip-path inset(round) on a viewport-sized scene when no content should scale with the doorway
gl-virtual-scroll-camera when the works need real depth of field, lighting or hundreds of items
